scope_of_estimate: guest configured memory reserve plus one observed interpreter peak only; not whole-run joint peak, excludes OS margin, other wrappers/build peaks; no fixed4GiB threshold
decision: No defensible physical safety margin under severe host pressure after owned jobs ended and supported task-kernel reset. Do not launch a one-shot canonical acceptance OOM gamble. No source defect inferred.
owned_cleanup: all build/test/QEMU completed; large execution objects GC collected and supported execution kernel reset; no remaining competing runner observed
next_boundary: User may free unused apps/tabs or explicitly authorize a specific graceful shutdown; then fresh native/source/review preflight, not repeated expensive verification.
